notes:
Jantri land rates. Every survey number in Anand and Kheda now shows the government (jantri) rate for that land — per square metre and per acre, with the land type and whether the parcel is on a highway or district road. Where the app knows the parcel's area, it also shows the total government value. Rates are the ASR-2011 figures with the 2023 doubling applied; this is the stamp-duty rate, not a market price.

Area now switches units: tap the area to move between hectare-are-sq.m, acre, vigha, guntha and square metres.

Total area and આકાર are now saved for every record. Older records fill these in when you tap Re-generate PDF — no CAPTCHA needed.
